title: Wbouncy-qq Almond Pasta
description: A rich and bouncy almond pasta dish for a brunch mood, perfect for those looking for a healthy yet indulgent meal. This egg-free-friendly recipe features delicious almonds in a light pasta-water-emulsion.

ingredients.name: pasta water emulsion
ingredients.notes: ensure it's heated to a rolling boil

instructions: In a large pot, combine pasta water emulsion and salt. Bring to a rolling boil.
Add almond paste to the boiling mixture and stir until dissolved.
Gradually fold in crushed almonds and minced garlic into the sauce.
Taste for seasoning and adjust with salt and pepper if necessary.
Drizzle in vegetable oil just before serving to create a glossy finish.
